who: the human-model seat (seat 12) and the AI players, per arm of P6
source: P6 harness runs (the turn-0 scenario of game 3, Marathon, Noble; seat 12 played by the human model; arm a: AI_BALANCE_SHARE 110, arm b: 0; S2 on in both), loaded by study/p6_load.sql from each run's telemetry (run.jsonl): capture events by and from the seat, war events on and by the seat and between AI teams, the turns played and the telemetry's milliseconds
sql: select arm, count(*) runs, sum((last_turn=300)::int) reached_300, median(taken) median_taken, sum(taken) total_taken, median(lost) median_lost, sum(lost) total_lost, sum((wars_on_seat>0)::int) runs_with_war_on_seat, sum(wars_on_seat) total_wars_on_seat, median(ai_ai_wars) median_ai_ai_wars, median(run_seconds) median_seconds from runs group by arm order by arm

who: the human-model seat (seat 12), per run of P6
source: as p6_arms, one row per run: the seed (from ledger.py seeds P6), the cities the seat took and lost, the wars declared on it and by it, the wars between AI teams, the last turn played
sql: select arm, seed, taken, lost, wars_on_seat, wars_by_seat, ai_ai_wars, last_turn from runs order by arm, seed
